title: Merge intervals
statement: Merge all overlapping closed intervals (touching intervals like [1, 4] and [4, 5] merge) and return them sorted by start.
hints: After sorting by start, an interval can only overlap the last merged one.

solution.explanation: Sort by start. Invariant: out holds disjoint merged intervals, and only the last can overlap anything still to come (every later interval starts at or after the current start). Extend the last one's end with max(), since a contained interval mustn't shrink it. The [1, 4], [2, 3] case catches the bug.
